dedupe_keys.name: zone vulcaniche art 142 c 1 lett l d lgs 142 2004

description: Zone vulcaniche (art. 142 c. 1 lett. l D.Lgs. 142/2004) is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by sitap.beniculturali.it. It contains the POLIGONAL elements representative of the volcanic areas protected under Article 142 c. 1 lit. l) of the Code. ATTRBUTI AND THEIR MEANING: CODVU, Number uniquely identifying the volcano, formed by REG (ISTAT code of the region) plus CODUN (4 digit sequential number); Name, Name of the volcano. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Volcanic zones (Article 142(1)(l) of Legislative Decree No 142/2004)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include vincoli paesaggistici, paesaggio, tutela paesaggistica. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
